item.title: OmniRoute
item.description:
## The Problem
Developers and teams juggle multiple AI providers—Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek—each with its own SDK, API key, and rate limits. Tracking free-tier quotas across dozens of providers is manual and error-prone. OmniRoute consolidates all of that behind a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
## What This Does
OmniRoute is an AI gateway that routes requests to 268+ providers (50+ free) through one API. It handles provider abstraction, quota tracking, auto-fallback, and token compress...

item.title: Gaussian Splat Lite
item.description:
## The Problem Rendering large, high‑fidelity 3D Gaussian splat scenes in a web browser is computationally expensive. Existing libraries either lack WebGPU support, cannot stream detail on‑the‑fly, or expose a confusing API. The project addresses those gaps by providing a **Three.js‑compatible renderer** that runs on WebGPU / WebGL2, streams RAD and SOG levels of detail, and offers stochastic rendering with optional neural denoising.

item.title: git ai
item.description:
## The Problem Hundreds of autonomous agents need to push and pull tiny changes in seconds, but classic Git services choke on full clones, merge queues, and client‑side history walks. The bottleneck is the need to materialize entire histories on the client while the server still verifies each commit.
## What This Does `gitai` implements a server‑centric model where the server answers all history queries and lands commits via compare‑and‑swap. * `cmd/gitaly/main.go` starts the gRPC server ...

item.title: web ocean

item.title: llm inference engineering
item.description:
